channelUrls.description: Channel handles, URLs, or channel IDs. The actor lists every public playlist, show, course, podcast, and album on each channel.
channelUrls.title: Channel URLs (list their playlists)

includeUnavailableVideos.description: Emit a placeholder row for each deleted, private, or hidden playlist entry, with its real position and thumbnail.
includeUnavailableVideos.title: Include Unavailable Videos

includeVideoDetails.description: Add exact views, likes, publish date, description, category, and tags for every available video. Turn off for a faster listing-only run.
includeVideoDetails.title: Include Exact Video Details

maxPlaylists.description: Maximum number of collections to list per channel.
maxPlaylists.title: Max Playlists Per Channel

maxSearchResults.description: Maximum number of playlist results to return for each search query.
maxSearchResults.title: Max Results Per Search

maxVideos.description: Maximum number of rows to return per playlist. Set to 0 for every video. Unavailable placeholders count toward the limit when enabled.
maxVideos.title: Max Videos Per Playlist

playlistUrls.description: YouTube playlist URLs, watch URLs with a list parameter, or bare playlist IDs whose videos you want. Combine with Channel URLs or Search Queries in one run.
playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search for public playlists and courses, for example "python course" or "lofi study". Up to 20 queries per run.
searchQueries.title: Playlist Search Queries
